author: reek
body: Composable monitoring dashboard. A MonitorLayout is a grid of panels, each bound to a data source and rendered with a chosen visualization. Users pick from a catalog of panel types, place them on the grid, resize them, and save the layout. Multiple layouts can be saved and switched between. Think Grafana: the same CPU data can show as a gauge, a sparkline, a number, or a table depending on the panel type.

author: reek
body: The key abstraction: a DataSource knows how to fetch a value. A PanelViz knows how to render it. A MonitorPanel binds them together and adds position/size on the grid. A MonitorLayout is just a list of panels. The monitor is the composition engine.
